svg.text: one secret polynomial fₖ as an n × n grid of xᵢ·xⱼ coefficients
vinegar × oil: linear in oil once vinegar is fixed
Hash the message and a salt to a target t ∈ F₂₅₆ᵐ
the m values the signature has to hit
Pick random values for the v vinegar variables
every α·vinegar·vinegar term becomes a constant
Each fₖ is now linear in the m oil variables
m equations in m unknowns, because oil × oil is zero
if the system is singular, go back to step 2
Undo the hiding map: s = T⁻¹(u)
s and the salt are the signature
What the public sees: P = F ∘ T
T mixes all n variables, so the zero block disappears from view. The structure survives as an m-dimensional
oil space on which P vanishes; every key-recovery attack on UOV is a search for that space.
verifying = evaluating 45 quadratic polynomials and comparing with the hash
public key = 45 × (119 · 120 / 2) coefficients = 321,300 bytes, or 46,591 bytes with most of them derived from a seed
